description: Department of Census & Statistics - National Consumer Price Index for the Month of December 2017 was 126.6
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for December 2017, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). This is a statistical announcement that falls under general administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
